notes.title: Hiding Spot (new game)! Pipe Push Paradise on consoles!
notes.notes:
Hi pals! 

My new game, a 3D puzzle game called [i]Hiding Spot[/i], is available now! In it, you push and pull your furniture around to build a safe place for yourself and get cozy. It's much smaller, but if you enjoyed PPP I think you'll have a nice time with this one too. :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/950140/Hiding_Spot/

But wait! Also!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30780166/1c9834e159823a90b258ce9fa258f22611ca56ba.jpg[/img]

Pipe Push Paradise is coming to Nintendo Switch on December 24th and PS4/Xbox One on February 8th! You'll be able to play it in so many places, which is very exciting. Not to mention that I grew up on consoles, so this is a special milestone for me. 

Ok, that's all. Play Hiding Spot! Thanks for reading :)

notes.title: v1.2.0 (new level set!)
notes.notes:
New major update! I got a bug report that inspired (burdened me with?) a whole new set of levels. The patch is now available as a free dl to anyone who owns the game.

I feel this update completes the game, and will now finally move on to other things, but feel free to email me about bugs/support anytime at corey(at)toboggan(dot)work.

Thanks for playing!
